OPERATING MODEL (Luneth-confirmed): (1) narrative/overview chapters (aging theory Ch1-3, nutrition primer Ch4, much of Ch6-9) = purify fully + mine SEARCH candidates only; mine tier-1 there only to enrich/add what the other 5 books lack, with a per-claim dedup check FIRST — verified choline->Huntington's, inositol->diabetic neuropathy, B6->epilepsy, and pellagra/scurvy/beriberi are all already mapped. detail:

chronicle/OVERHAUL-BLUEPRINT.md (29 KB, 8 sections, every one Luneth-verified section-by-section). Charter R1-R9: every rule ships its machine gate in the same patch; a rule with no gate is labeled WISH and never sold as safe (the honesty mechanism that stops "promises" masquerading as guarantees). Core architecture: TWO hand-edited sealed sources — the Wallach Corpus (eden/corpus/, already exists and is well-engineered) and a NEW Youngevity Product DB (eden/products/, Luneth hand-mines later) — plus a shared Catalog pillar (eden/catalog/: essentials + NEW nutrient vocabulary + conditions/symptoms promoted from emergent-slugs to pre-registered IDs). EVERYTHING else is generated by a deterministic, network-free, timestamp-free pipeline (build_embeds) and gated by derived_artifacts_fresh, which regenerates every artifact and byte-compares to disk — so a hand-edited or stale generated file fails the board. The key finding that reframed the whole effort: the recurring pain was a SECOND, unguarded parallel system — knowledge/essentials-targets.json → data.json → embeds → Coverage — hand-maintained alongside the CLEAN corpus→indices→corpus-embed→Knowledge-drawer system that already enforces most of the Charter. The overhaul COLLAPSES the rotten system into the clean one; it does not rebuild Eden. Decisions locked: Q1-Q3 (build nutrients.json; conditions/symptoms as canonical catalog; verbatim becomes a pointer to a real claim so fabricating a quote is structurally impossible — the exact bug that started this — and the modern-voice summary becomes a single-copy prose-store field), D1-D4 (migrate all embeds to one esbuild-import mechanism so dashboard.html sheds ~130 KB and becomes a pure shell; a generated-file manifest so nothing is silently unchecked; reconcile the two catalogs; Search = retrieval-first to protect the never-breaks/fully-portable vision, upgradeable to a bundled model later). Enforcement: 43 invariants dispositioned — 3 rotten-layer guards (wallach_stance_embed_sync/_source_rule/_verbatim_in_book) deleted, ~10 new Charter gates added; the count is not the target, coverage of named failure modes is (honest pushback on Luneth's "no way we need 43" hunch, which he accepted). Migration = 9 phases A-I, board green at each (build→test→log→repeat), nothing deleted until its replacement generates correctly. Accepted trade (7.1): Wallach-only targets mean essentials with no maintenance-dose claim yet show an honest "no target stated" until Phase G mining fills them — correct per R2 (no Youngevity fallback), Luneth explicitly okayed the loss of some currently-defined values. Flags resolved 2026-07-05: dashboard/.git (stray hooks-only dir, remove), wallach-refresh/logs (delete — not a sacred log; only the Creator's Log carries the old record), labels/ (relocate to a new tests/scanner-labels/ home), corpus-changelog.md + genesis/01 (delete, backed up), root package.json (keep — puppeteer for probes). detail:
Luneth re-sent his original overhaul prompt and had me audit everything we built against that vision. The audit found four places where our promise of a system "impossible to compromise" was still just a promise. This chunk turns all four into real, machine-checked gates, each proven to fail loudly when broken. Nothing here changes what the app shows; it hardens the rules that keep our data honest.

Four new critical invariants (board 41 -> 45):

- data_artifacts_accounted (R1 completeness): every dashboard/assets/data/*.json must be registered in eden/derived/MANIFEST.json -- either in `artifacts` (derived + freshness-gated) or in the new `accounted` block (hand-authored/externally-gated, each with disposition+reason). summary: Phase F kickoff: built the Youngevity Product DB pillar + a negative-tested prose-containment gate, and catalogued the first 2 products (18/20 Daily combo, 3.0 Rise & Restore) straight from their labels
detail:
Kicked off Phase F — building the Youngevity Product DB, the sealed record of exactly what's inside every Youngevity product. This is the data that lets the app answer "does my regimen hit my Wallach targets?", "which product gives me the most selenium per dollar?", and "which products have a good antioxidant blend?" — for all 91 essentials. We designed the whole data model on paper with Luneth first, then proved it works on real labels before scaling.

DESIGN (locked with Luneth over this session): composition lives in the sealed pillar as PURE FACTS; prices + the Youngevity marketing description live in a SEPARATE volatile sidecar (prices change often — sealing them would churn the hash), tagged source:ygy and quarantined so a YGY marketing claim can never masquerade as a Wallach claim or a target (§00.A). Every blend is captured IN FULL — name, total mg, and its ordered ingredient list (label order = descending amount by FDA rule) — with a bounded as_labeled verbatim token for exact-wording search, plus structured tokens (part/form/latin/standardization/sub-amounts) so nothing is ever lost and cross-product ingredient search works. Nested sub-blends (a blend inside a blend, e.g. the Mushroom Blend) are captured recursively. Every ingredient will resolve to the rebuilt Catalog nutrient/botanical registry (later chunk), re-lighting references_resolve's dormant substance half.

BUILT THIS CHUNK: eden/products/products.json (Batch 1 = the 18 Daily / 20 Daily combo as one product with two capsule components incl. the nested Mushroom Blend; Batch 2 = 3.0 Rise & Restore as one product with two powder components — ~28 quantified vitamins/minerals with form + %DV + IU, and 13 named proprietary blends with totals + ordered ingredients + mushroom Latin binomials + standardization markers). eden/products/prices.json (all 432 listings auto-generated from the saved listing .mhtml manifest — zero hand-typing; retail/wholesale/BV/QV/description; keyed by ygy_id). eden/products/README.md (the locked schema + §00.A boundary + the enforcement suite). eden/tools/products_verify.py — the structural + prose-containment gate.

HARDENING (applying the audit lessons — ship the gate with the thing, prove it with a negative test): products_verify validates record structure AND blocks prose leakage — the only long free-text field allowed anywhere is a blend's bounded, single-line as_labeled token; every other string must be a short structured token with no sentence shape. Proven RED on a negative test (a marketing sentence injected into an ingredient name was caught). The fuller suite (products_hash_integrity + golden seal, references_resolve substance-half, product_labels_accounted completeness gate, products_derived_fresh, product_amounts_not_targets boundary) lands as the pillar completes; products_verify wires into the invariants board then.

Batch 1 user-signed-off (schema + a hard dense multi-panel label, Tai Wellness, read accurately as a stress test); Batch 2 pending Luneth's spot-check. summary: Book-mining coverage gate landed (Proposal A) — wholesale under-mining now a red board at completion
detail:
Added the missing anti-drift leg for book mining, from the 3-step system we designed this session (gate + manual checkpoint + end-audit). Book mining already had leg 1 (corpus_verify proves every captured claim well-formed) and leg 3 (corpus_audit_gate, the human end-audit). It was missing leg 2's analog of the product label-accounting gate: COVERAGE. Nothing proved we captured everything, so whole chapters/appendices/books were silently skipped (DDDL Appendix-B long tail; Immortality 0 claims for ~40 sessions) and only caught late, forcing whole-book re-mines. Same silent-absence class as the PreWorkout Pixie miss, at book scale.

New: eden/tools/mining-coverage.json (per-book ledger) + tools/invariants.py check_mining_coverage_accounted (board 45->46, critical). For a book flagged mining_status:'complete', every source page (screenshot-scheme) or section (chapter-scheme) must be claim-bearing OR reviewed-empty-with-reason, else RED. Claim-bearing pages auto-derive from sealed locator.char_offset -> nearest '===== Screenshot(N) =====' marker (ONE consistent text-position basis; I empirically verified locator.screenshot is populated inconsistently per book -- epigenetics by Page, iaiyh/immortality by marker N -- and deliberately did NOT use it; validated char_offset->marker reproduces known assignments iaiyh 20/20, immortality 196/196 BEFORE building). 'incomplete' books (all 6 today) report an informational coverage snapshot and NEVER red the board -- same design as book_source_clean asserting only pristine books, so the legitimately-incomplete corpus stays green. Reasons follow exceptions_justified. Scope: WHOLESALE accounting only; per-claim completeness stays with corpus_audit, faithfulness with the manual mining checkpoint.

Verified: invariants 46/46 green; NEGATIVE TEST -- iaiyh flagged complete with 15 unresolved zero-claim pages -> RED with exact page list, then restored -> green. The gate immediately surfaced the known under-mining: immortality 49/254 pages (205 zero-claim), epigenetics 66/465 (399 zero-claim), iaiyh 19/34. This is a forcing-function tune-up for Phase G; it runs no mining and changes no claim. Products flow untouched -- resume at the U-range. memory: dddl-undermined-remine, immortality-mining-policy, full-corpus-audit-before-phase-g.
